text: Peevyhouse connects contractual purpose and bargaining evidence to the measure of damages. Its facts show why a complete remedies analysis must distinguish market value, personal value, and the performance expressly purchased.
sourceSummary: The majority limited recovery for unperformed mine-restoration work to the farm’s $300 diminution in value because it treated restoration as incidental to the lease and its cost as grossly disproportionate to its economic benefit.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
